neighbours.label: technical terms of mathematics and theoretical physics (fermions, spacetime, rings of integers, geodesics); everyday prose stays low
fire: In the standard model, quarks and leptons are fermions with half-integer spin.
General relativity describes gravity as the curvature of spacetime.
Every Dedekind domain, such as the ring of integers of a number field, has unique factorization of ideals.
Light rays follow null geodesics in a curved spacetime.
Pairs of electrons can behave like bosons even though each electron is a fermion.
The Riemann tensor measures how much parallel transport around a loop fails to commute.
A scheme is locally isomorphic to the spectrum of a commutative ring.
The Dirac equation predicts antiparticles for every charged fermion.
quiet: In the old village, bakers and butchers open their shops at dawn.
Good friendship describes trust as the core of a long relationship.
Every kitchen, such as the one in my grandmother's house, has a drawer of spoons.
Hikers follow narrow paths through the forest in early autumn.
Pairs of swans can stay together for life even in busy city parks.
The recipe measures how much sugar the cake needs for a sweet crust.
A garden is usually prettier in spring than in the middle of winter.
The weather report predicts rain for every town along the coast.
